name: Nashville
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Nashville for 2026, and here is what he found: 30 family events, 9 of them free. The magic runs from November 6 (ICE featuring Home Alone at Gaylord Opryland) through January 3 (Glow Wild at Nashville Zoo and Holiday LIGHTS at Cheekwood), with the Nashvillage Holiday Market (December 3 to 13), Nashville Nights Under Lights at Riverfront Park (December 5 and 12) and the Jacksonian Christmas Festival at Tulip Grove (December 5) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Nashville

  • 30 Christmas events for kids in Nashville
  • 9 free events, including the Nashvillage Holiday Market, the Shop Local Holiday Market with Santa, Nashville Nights Under Lights and the Ashland City Christmas Parade
  • Meet Santa: Jacksonian Christmas Festival at Tulip Grove, Breakfast with Santa at Dave and Buster's, the Shop Local Holiday Market and Holiday Central at Nashville Yards
  • Lights: ICE featuring Home Alone, Glow Wild, Holiday LIGHTS at Cheekwood, Nashville Nights Under Lights, Holiday Central at Nashville Yards and the Mistletoe Trail at Riverbluff Park in Ashland City
  • Parades: the Ashland City Christmas Parade (December 5)
  • Trains: the Santa Express at the Tennessee Central Railway Museum
  • Season: November 6, 2026 to January 3, 2027
